body.purpose: Record details, supporting text, and standard controls.

time.purpose: Aligned start-time columns in agenda and schedule rows.

shadows.name: selected-segment
shadows.purpose: Lift the selected tab inside a segmented control.

shadows.name: primary-action
shadows.purpose: Give the primary scheduling action a restrained affordance.

components.name: Primary Schedule Action
components.description: The full-width action that opens an allowed scheduling path.
components.css: .ds-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 54px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #234ed8; color: #fff; font: 750 17px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(35,78,216,.26); cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #1538a3; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #234ed8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Selected Date Tile
components.description: A compact day tile in the horizontally scrollable schedule rail.
components.css: .ds-date { display: grid; align-content: center; gap: 4px; width: 68px; min-height: 74px; border: 1px solid #234ed8; border-radius: 13px; background: #234ed8; color: #fff; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-date span { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-date strong { font-size: 24px; line-height: 1; } .ds-date:hover { background: #1538a3; } .ds-date:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8eafff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Confirmed Status
components.description: A server-owned confirmed-state label; color is never the only carrier of meaning.
components.css: .ds-status-confirmed { display: inline-block; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e3f7ea; color: #116333; font: 700 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Waitlist Status
components.description: An amber text-bearing status for pending or waitlist outcomes.
components.css: .ds-status-pending { display: inline-block; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff1d8; color: #914400; font: 700 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Agenda Row
components.description: A time-led personal record with quiet supporting detail and status.
components.css: .ds-agenda { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 78px 1fr; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 0; color: #152538; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-agenda time { font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 780; letter-spacing: -.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-agenda div { display: grid; gap: 7px; min-width: 0; padding-left: 16px; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #dfe6ef; } .ds-agenda strong { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-agenda span { color: #64748b; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-agenda em { justify-self: start; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e3f7ea; color: #116333; font-size: 13px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: The sticky four-route Telegram-sized navigation bar.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 4px; padding: 8px; border-top: 1px solid #dfe6ef; background: #fff; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 50px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #64748b; font-size: 23px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav small { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav button.is-active { color: #234ed8; } .ds-nav button:hover { color: #1538a3; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #234ed8; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The Mini App presents a client's immediate schedule as a quiet, date-led plan inside Telegram. White/cool-gray surfaces, navy text, and cobalt selection keep times and allowed actions prominent. The server owns availability and lifecycle state; the UI renders that result with a written status label.
keyCharacteristics: Flat mobile layout with selective cobalt elevation

rules.name: Status Is Evidence
rules.body: Status colors always accompany a server-provided label; controls do not infer state.

rules.name: Flat By Default
rules.body: Use borders, spacing, and tonal fills for grouping; reserve shadows for selected cobalt controls.

dos: Do lead with date, time, state, and permitted next action.
Do preserve Telegram host chrome and its active dark theme.
Do reuse legacy flows behind the week shell where they remain established.
donts: Don't use color alone for booking state.
Don't invent availability, price, permissions, or lifecycle transitions in the client.
Don't add promotional hero treatments or card mosaics to task flows.
